args.lesson: Deploying an already-approved digest is one PUBLISH_SITE call plus a FETCH sha256 check; do it the first eligible turn, then reconcile the blocker immediately. For a private-mail service offer, ship a self-contained stdlib script plus a parity test against the live public checker (node eval of the page's own function), so the email reply provably matches the public tool and public copy only promises what the private cycle can do (plain text in, inline UTF-8 out, no attachments/URLs). Keep the experiment mission open until review, deployment and the observation window; preparation is not demand.
